title: Open embedding sheaf pullback preserves injectives
statement: Let X and Y be topological spaces and f : X → Y an open embedding. Pullback of abelian sheaves along f preserves injective objects.

source.place: Exact extension by zero is left adjoint to restriction along an open embedding, and restriction preserves injectives.

proof.text: Use the extension-by-zero adjunction whose left adjoint preserves monomorphisms for an open embedding.
Apply the adjunction criterion that a right adjoint to a mono-preserving functor preserves injective objects.

proof_origin.place: Extension by zero adjunction and exactness for open embeddings.
